profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’ve always stayed motivated in my career through a genuine love of programming and the fun of untangling complex problems with a solid team. Early on, that meant instilling a love of the process of learning. Today, it looks more like leading C#/.NET backend projects, cleaning up heavy legacy systems, and helping and teaching other engineers.

Recently, I’ve been heavily involved in figuring out how to practically integrate AI-assisted tools into our daily workflows. I’ve had a blast doing it. I have loved cutting out the busywork so we can focus on building reliable code and shipping features faster.

I really enjoy the mentoring side of being a senior engineer. Whether I'm teaching a team seminar on unit testing, guiding a junior developer, or just mapping out a realistic architecture on a whiteboard, I love helping people think through problems and build a true engineering mindset.

As I keep moving forward, my goal is pretty simple: architect clean solutions, build systems that don't break, and ship sweet products alongside awesome people.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer driving core development, system modernization, and AI-assisted engineering practices for enterprise ERP and cloud platforms. 

Selected as one of four engineers company-wide to pilot the organization's AI Development Program, establishing scalable AI-driven SDLC patterns, human-in-the-loop verification, and developer productivity workflows for the broader engineering team.

Key Contributions & Engineering Focus:
• AI Integration & Automation: Pioneered agentic workflows and local AI architectures, creating context maps and verification frameworks that streamline feature development and drastically reduce code-review rework.
• Enterprise Integrations: Architected and delivered cross-system APIs (REST/SOAP) to seamlessly connect legacy on-premise ERP modules with modern cloud infrastructure.
• Security & Compliance: Championed system security by remediating critical application vulnerabilities (including transport layer risks and information exposure) and implemented robust rate-limiting to secure authentication pathways.
• Platform Scalability & Core Architecture: Solved complex domain challenges across financial, sales, and service modules, optimizing database performance and ensuring data integrity in high-traffic, multi-tenant environments.
• Release Engineering & Quality: Managed automated testing pipelines (tSQLt, xUnit) and zero-downtime hotfix deployments, ensuring strict reliability for critical financial and operational systems.

positions.title: QA & Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Transitioned from QA responsibilities to full-stack development during a core proof-of-concept project. Architected and implemented the primary testing framework that was adopted by the engineering team for current and future product releases. Contributed directly to application development using C# and Java.

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Tutor
positions.description: Mentored students in C++ and Java with a focus on developing an actual engineering mindset. Rather than simply providing solutions, I guided students through the problem-solving and debugging processes, helping them build the independence and critical thinking skills needed to understand algorithms, data structures, and foundational programming practices.

positions.title: Communication Trainee
positions.description: Designed, installed and serviced high-speed cable and fiber optic cabling systems for data and voice networks.
